title: Two GK Cubes and a Roof — Ankerstein Mesh Demo
subtitle: A real proof: spex's mesh-rendering pipeline (MeshBundleBuilder, real triangles/edges/shading), previously LDraw/LEGO-only, generalized to a real procedurally-generated Ankerstein assembly with no source file to parse.

shots.title: Two Cubes, a Roof
shots.note: A static, framed 3/4 view of the real Ankerstein mesh scene: two 25mm GK cubes (generate_box) side by side, with a real 45-degree GK prism (generate_prism) spanning both as a roof — chosen over a pure-box pyramid specifically because it exercises both real shape generators together, so the prism's sloped-face shading and its real analytic edges (generate_prism_edges) are visibly proven, not just the box's.
